actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if command -v qemu-system-i386 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU_BIN=qemu-system-i386; elif command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then QEMU_BIN=qemu-system-x86_64; else echo 'QEMU not installed' >&2; exit 1; fi
nohup "$QEMU_BIN" -snapshot -m 64 -hda /app/isos/win311.img -vnc 127.0.0.1:1 -monitor unix:/app/run/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait -serial mon:stdio -display none > /app/run/qemu.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /app/run/qemu.pid
sleep 2
ps -p "$(cat /app/run/qemu.pid)" -o pid=,cmd=
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':5901\b|:80\b' || true
actions.note: Launch QEMU in snapshot mode with VNC :1 and a monitor socket for programmatic keyboard injection.
